label: 02_utilization_samples
command:
/root/miniconda3/bin/python -B - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,time,datetime
for number in range(6):
 gpu=subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=uuid,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.total,memory.used,memory.free,power.draw,temperature.gpu','--format=csv,noheader'],capture_output=True,text=True)
 processes=subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-compute-apps=gpu_uuid,pid,process_name,used_gpu_memory','--format=csv,noheader'],capture_output=True,text=True)
 print(json.dumps({'sample':number,'time':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'gpu':gpu.stdout.strip(),'gpu_exit':gpu.returncode,'gpu_stderr':gpu.stderr,'compute_processes':processes.stdout.strip(),'process_query_exit':processes.returncode,'process_stderr':processes.stderr}),flush=True)
 if number<5:time.sleep(2)

PY
